title: Remove false verbatim source authority: synthesized table headers and composed sourceText (19.2.1 item 5)
description:
Slice of eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 item 5, selected as the first repair of the 2026-09-22 ADR-0020 recovery sequence (source -> capture -> identity/provenance -> emitted pack).

DEFECT CLASS: a value the importer composed or synthesized is emitted at a pointer that field-provenance-v1 (packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/field-provenance.json) declares 'source-prose' - the only class the context packet presents to the DM as verbatim, authoritative source. Discovery places such text into context as authority (ADR 0020 Consequences), so this launders compiler-authored text through the authoritative channel.

KNOWN MEMBERS (verified on main 2026-09-22):
- table:scrying-save-modifiers: merges the SRD's two printed Scrying save-modifier tables under invented column headers 'Basis'/'Circumstance'; table /columns is declared source-prose.
- class spellPreparation.sourceText (e.g. class:cleric): stitches two separate SRD passages into one string; /spellPreparation/sourceText is declared source-prose.

SIBLING SEARCH: enumerate every value emitted at a source-prose pointer and check it against the pinned source extraction; repair every non-verbatim member, or reclassify the pointer truthfully where the field is not a quotation by design.

EVIDENCE: one generalized invariant at the correct boundary - a value emitted at a source-prose pointer is a verbatim span of the pinned source (modulo documented whitespace/hyphenation normalization) - rather than per-example reproducers. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; regenerate the pack; npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack must stay green.

OUT OF SCOPE: 19.2.1 item 2 (Animal Friendship) and item 3 (Bag of Beans, repaired with the half-damage class).
